'''Hewex''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[human]] who served as a [[major]]<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> in the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Hewex led [[Imperial Navy Trooper]]s alongside [[Colonel]] [[Dyer]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Biography==
During the war, he was stationed on the [[moon]] of [[Endor]] in as part of a [[Tempest Force|garrison]] stationed within a [[Death Star's shield generator|bunker]] housing a [[Deflector shield generator|shield generator]], which provided protection for the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station]] [[Space station|battlestation]] being built in Endor's orbit. The Major, alongside [[Commander]] [[Altadan Igar]],<ref name="USW" /> supported the bunker's commander, [[Colonel]] [[Dyer]].<ref name="SWFC">''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]''</ref> During the [[Battle of Endor]], in which the Alliance attacked the incomplete Death Star, a [[Endor strike team|team]] of Rebels was sent to the moon's surface in order to destroy the shield generator bunker. At first, the Rebels took control of the bunker's control room and held the Imperial personnel, including Hewex against the wall at gunpoint. When Imperial reinforcements arrived, he wrestled the Rebel [[Chewbacca]]'s [[bowcaster]] from him.<ref name="ROTJ" />

As the Rebels were led outside, the Imperials were attacked by [[Ewok]]s and chaos ensued. Hewex and several other Imperials sealed themselves inside of the bunker as the Ewoks assisted the Rebels fighting the Imperials. Eventually, the Rebel [[General]] [[Han Solo]] successfully tricked<ref name="ROTJ" /> a nervous<ref name="Odyssey">''[[The Odyssey of Star Wars: An Epic Poem]]''</ref> Hewex into opening the door by posing as Major [[Newland]]. Hewex sent several [[squad]]s of Imperial [[trooper]]s stationed in the bunker out to aid in the fighting, but found it was a trick and the Rebels entered the bunker. Hewex and the remaining men in the bunker were then forced to surrender to the Alliance [[soldier]]s, who planted [[Bomb|charges]]. The Rebels were ultimately successful in destroying both the bunker and the Death Star.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Personality and traits==
Hewex had fair skin and [[Color|brown]] [[hair]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hewex first appeared albeit unidentified in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="ROTJ" /> He was first identified in the ''[[Endor Limited]]'' set of the ''[[Star Wars Legends]]'' [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]]<ref name="TCG">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=Major Hewex}}</ref> with the name then being confirmed as [[canon]] by the reference book ''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''.<ref name="USW" /> In [[2021]], ''[[The Odyssey of Star Wars: An Epic Poem]]'' referred to him as a [[captain]].<ref name="Odyssey" /> This article treats the captain reference as an error.
